units.teams: points a game vs an average major-college team, neutral field (ridge SRS on margin capped at 35)
units.offense: points scored a game over average, schedule-adjusted
units.defense: points allowed a game under average, schedule-adjusted

pk.t: adjusted yards over an average FBS QB that season: (TAY/P - season average) x plays; TAY/P = (pass yds + 20 x pass TD - 45 x INT + rush yds + 20 x rush TD) / (attempts + rushes), sacks count as rushes. no opponent adjustment

car.t: career Yds+: each season's adjusted yards over an average FBS QB, summed (seasons among the top 150 passers)

qbs.peak_about: FBS regular seasons 2004-2025, QBs with 150+ attempts; the season average and SD over the same QBs; every player-season ranks on its own.
qbs.career_about: FBS regular seasons from 2004 (careers that started earlier count from 2004), 300+ attempts.
qbs.svT: SV (season value): points over replacement a game that season, EPA a play (QB dropbacks + runs; runs + targets; defenders: credited EPA on negative plays) less the opponent's rate where it helped, replacement moved with that season's league EPA (era); CFB 2014 on (cfbfastR play-by-play), FBS games
qbs.svarT: SVAR = SV points over replacement that season, in wins: points x .0189 (FBS: win % rises .0189 a point of margin a game, 12 games)

pk.t: adjusted scrimmage yards over the season's average starter at the position: AY = rush + rec yds + 20 x TD - 45 x fumbles lost, minus the mean AY of that season's top RB 100 / WR 200 / TE 40. volume, not per target (no targets in the college history)

car.t: career Yds+: each season's adjusted yards over the average starter at his position, summed (seasons among the top 150 rushers / 450 receivers)

players.peak_about: FBS regular seasons 2004-25: RB, WR, TE (ESPN position; FB as RB); every player-season ranks on its own. QBs on their own lists; defense, OL and specialists left out (no usable per-player history).
players.career_about: FBS regular seasons from 2004 (careers that started earlier count from 2004).
players.svT: SV (season value): points over replacement a game that season, EPA a play (QB dropbacks + runs; runs + targets; defenders: credited EPA on negative plays) less the opponent's rate where it helped, replacement moved with that season's league EPA (era); CFB 2014 on: RBs on runs; WR, TE and RB targets 2025 on (target ids)
players.svarT: SVAR = SV points over replacement that season, in wins: points x .0189 (FBS: win % rises .0189 a point of margin a game, 12 games)

units.teams: points a game vs an average team, neutral field (ridge SRS on margin capped at 35)
units.offense: points scored a game over average, schedule-adjusted
units.defense: points allowed a game under average, schedule-adjusted

pk.t: NFL WAR (AV WAR, no special teams), 2012 on (snap counts), on 17 games (2012-20 x 17 / 16)

car.t: career NFL WAR: seasons 2012 on, earlier seasons est from weighted career AV

players.estT: seasons before 2012: weighted career AV x pre-2012 share of his seasons x 0.035 (fit on 2003-11 draftees' 2012-on WAR, r 0.82)
players.peak_about: WAR seasons 2012 on, on 17 games; every player-season ranks on its own. SV seasons 1999 on (defenders 2013 on): the list holds the top by WAR and the top by SV.
players.career_about: NFL WAR 2012 on; earlier careers est from weighted career AV (drafted players 1980 on).
players.svT: SV (season value): points over replacement a game that season, EPA a play (QB dropbacks + runs; runs + targets; defenders: credited EPA on negative plays) less the opponent's rate where it helped, replacement moved with that season's league EPA (era); NFL 1999 on (defenders 2013 on, snap counts); WAR 2012 on
players.svarT: SVAR = SV points over replacement that season, in wins: points / 36 a win (the game model), on 17 games (1999-2020 x 17 / 16)

pk.t: NFL WAR (AV WAR, no special teams), 2012 on (snap counts), on 17 games (2012-20 x 17 / 16)

car.t: career NFL WAR: seasons 2012 on, earlier seasons est from weighted career AV

qbs.estT: seasons before 2012: weighted career AV x pre-2012 share of his seasons x 0.035 (fit on 2003-11 draftees' 2012-on WAR, r 0.82)
qbs.peak_about: WAR seasons 2012 on, on 17 games; every player-season ranks on its own. SV seasons 1999 on (defenders 2013 on): the list holds the top by WAR and the top by SV.
qbs.career_about: NFL WAR 2012 on; earlier careers est from weighted career AV (drafted players 1980 on).
qbs.svT: SV (season value): points over replacement a game that season, EPA a play (QB dropbacks + runs; runs + targets; defenders: credited EPA on negative plays) less the opponent's rate where it helped, replacement moved with that season's league EPA (era); NFL 1999 on (defenders 2013 on, snap counts); WAR 2012 on
qbs.svarT: SVAR = SV points over replacement that season, in wins: points / 36 a win (the game model), on 17 games (1999-2020 x 17 / 16)

units.teams: Sports Reference SRS: points a game vs an average D-I team
units.offense: OSRS: offensive points a game over average, schedule-adjusted
units.defense: DSRS: points prevented a game, schedule-adjusted

pk.t: wins over a replacement player: (BPM + 2) x minutes / 40 x .68 x wins a point (CBB WAR)

players.eraT: Era: BPM against that season's regulars (400+ min), minutes against that season's 90th pct, in 2017-2026 units.

units.teams: Basketball Reference SRS: points a game vs an average team
units.offense: ORtg over the league: points a 100 possessions
units.defense: DRtg under the league: points a 100 possessions

pk.t: wins over replacement on XPM: .030 x (XPM + 1.4) x MP / 48, per 82 games, in today's units
pk.rt: XPM (DPM + BPM blend from 2009-10; BPM alone before)

car.t: career VORX, each season per 82 games in today's units

players.estT: before 1973-74 (no BPM): XPM from WS/48 and PER, fit on 1974-85 (r 0.90)
players.peak_about: Regular season. XPM = DPM + BPM blend from 2009-10, BPM alone 1973-74 to 2008-09.
players.eraT: Era: XPM against that season's regulars (mean, SD), minutes per 82 against that season's 90th pct load, both in 2017-2026 units; BPM is per 100 possessions, so pace is already out.

units.teams: Hockey Reference SRS: goals a game vs an average team
units.offense: goals for a game over the league + half the SOS
units.defense: goals against a game under the league + half the SOS

pk.t: NHL WAR (2008-09 on), per 82 games, in today's units

car.t: career WAR, each season per 82 games in today's units

players.estT: before 2008-09: WAR from point shares (skaters r 0.73, goalies r 0.81 on the seasons both have)
players.peak_about: NHL WAR from 2008-09; earlier seasons est from point shares.
players.eraT: Era: WAR per 82 against that season's regulars (mean, SD), skaters and goalies apart, in 2017-2026 units.

units.teams: goals a match vs the big-five average club, neutral ground (season end)
units.offense: attack: goals scored a match over the big-five average
units.defense: defence: goals conceded a match under the big-five average

pk.t: goals above replacement (soccer GAR), big-five leagues

players.svT: SV (season value): goals over replacement a 90 that season from that season alone (GAR's weights on its inputs with a one-season xG plus-minus, plus finishing and keeper saves at face value), as played; 2014-15 on
players.svarT: SVAR = SV x 90s played: the season total in goals, GAR scale, as played
players.eraT: Era: GAR per 90 against that season's regulars (900+ min), minutes against that season's 90th pct, in 2017-2026 units.

units.teams: Valve VRS points, best snapshot of the year

pk.t: rounds won over a replacement player: RWA over replacement x rounds / 100, in today's units (RWA vs that year's players, rounds vs that year's load)
pk.rt: round win % added per round over that year's replacement level

car.t: career RAR, each year in today's units

players.peak_about: Calendar years, 2024 on; current year to date.
players.eraT: Era: RWA against that year's regulars (1,000+ rounds), rounds against that year's 90th pct, in 2024-2026 units.

pk.t: NHLe against drafted prospects of his age and position that season: 100 = average, +25 = one SD
pk.rt: points per 82 NHL games at the league factor, as played

car.t: sum of seasons over 100, in SDs

players.peak_about: Drafted skaters (2008 on), seasons outside the NHL at 20+ games, ages 16-21 (on Dec 31).
players.ut: NHLe in today's units for his age and position (season mean and SD set to the last 10 seasons')
players.eraT: Era: log NHLe against drafted skaters of the same age and position that season (SD pooled +- 2 seasons).

pk.t: peak Elo that year against the year's #20 (100) in SDs of the year's top 100 (x25)

car.t: sum of year-end Elo over the year's #20, in SDs of the year's top 100

players.peak_about: Tour-level singles; peak counts after 40 matches.
players.eraT: Era: Elo against that year's #20, in SDs of that year's top 100.

pk.t: peak Elo that year against the year's #20 (100) in SDs of the year's top 100 (x25)

car.t: sum of year-end Elo over the year's #20, in SDs of the year's top 100
